rule: Every shipped model appears exactly once. None disappears because data was unavailable.

battery.cell.rint_ocv.why: Two configurations, opposite results, on the same cell and the same measurement. With a declared measured curve it reproduces held-out open-circuit voltage inside the preregistered tolerance. With the affine chord it misses by up to 293 mV. Reporting either alone would be reporting half the evidence.

electrical.material.linear_tcr_resistanc.why: Against a standards-body reference table its deviation is the omitted quadratic term to better than 5 percent from 50 degC upward, and the residual's quadratic coefficient matches |B| R0 to four significant figures. It is PARTIAL and not VALIDATED because six scored entries at the low end fail the rule as preregistered, because the reference is a transcription rather than the licensed document, and because it is a standardised relation rather than a measurement of a specimen.

electrical.material.rated_linear_tcr_res.why: Its constitutive law is the one above and carries that evidence. The claim that distinguishes it - the linearization band and the maximum operating temperature - has no measured rating behind it for any conductor used here.

electrical.dc.kcl.why: ngspice 42, LEVEL 4, from the previous round. No physical measurement.

electrical.dc.resistor_ohm.why: ngspice 42, LEVEL 4, from the previous round.

electrical.dc.ideal_voltage_source.why: ngspice 42, LEVEL 4, from the previous round.

electrical.dc.ideal_current_source.why: ngspice 42, LEVEL 4, from the previous round.

electrical.dc.regulated_voltage_source.why: Covered numerically by the previous round; its regulation band is a caller's declaration with no external number to be right about.

electrical.dc.self_heated_resistor.why: Covered numerically by the previous round; no datasheet with a measured element-to-body thermal resistance is reachable.

thermal.lumped.first_order_capacity.why: No measured transient with independently known C and hA is reachable. Rounds 5 and 6 validated it mathematically and against an independently constructed problem; neither is a measurement.

thermal.conduction1d.linear_diffusion.why: No measured transient is reachable, and the quantity this model predicts - the decay of an exactly half-sine initial profile - is not one an experiment produces.

battery.cell.coulomb_counting.why: See MVF-5: the only measured constant-current discharge dataset available does not record the current.

battery.cell.peukert_capacity_derating.why: See MVF-5. This is the model the available data comes closest to fitting, and the gap is one column.

kinetics.cstr.nonisothermal_first_order.why: The one measured reactor experiment found was rejected at the provenance lock. CODATA fixes a constant the model is handed and validates nothing the model predicts.

kinetics.cstr.nonisothermal_first_order_.why: Declared in the repository as a comparison approximation rather than a claim about a physical system.
